_comment: Reconstructed from chain data: the upgrade script executed the cut but its post-check read a lagging RPC replica (old facet still reported) and threw before writing this record. Verified afterwards: submitBatchBlocks routes to newFacet on three consecutive reads, newFacet runtime bytecode is byte-identical to the local fixed build (library address substituted), the library is byte-identical to the local BlockHeaderUtils, the other 11 oracle selectors remain on oldFacet, and the oracle state is unchanged by the cut.
